title: Softmax & Cross-Entropy
tagline: Turn logits into probabilities, read off the loss, and watch the gradient become p minus y
summary: Slide three logits, pick the true class, and turn the temperature knob. See the softmax probabilities, the cross-entropy loss -log(p_true) as one big number, and the backprop gradient p - y as signed bars. Four presets — confident-and-right through confident-and-wrong — make the punchline obvious: the loss punishes confident mistakes hardest, and the gradient that fixes them is exactly predicted minus target.
highlights: Watch softmax map three logits to a probability simplex, live, with the true class highlighted.
Read the cross-entropy loss -log(p_true) as one big number and feel how fast it explodes as the true-class probability drops.
See the gradient of the loss with respect to the logits is exactly p - y, drawn as signed push-up / push-down bars.
Four one-click presets contrast correct-and-confident with the brutal cost of being confident and wrong.
A temperature knob sharpens or flattens the distribution so you can connect this page to distillation and calibration.
